xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Hind Inns & Hotels Ltd. & M/s Hind Motors
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: Section 9 under Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 was filed by us seeking interim measures against the security of amount under Arbitral Award, since three months waiting period for filing execution application was not over by the time of its filing i.e. on 01.04.2025, however, in the meantime statutory waiting period of 90 was over and we were in the process of filing of our Execution Application for enforcement of the Arbitral Award therefore this Sec 9 Arbitration Application was disposed of granting liberty to the Petitioner to take recourse to appropriate proceedings for enforcement.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: In the matter of Fleur Hotels (“Claimant”), Hind Inns & Hotels Ltd. & M/s Hind Motors (“Respondents”), Respondents have filed this Petition challenging the Arbitral Award dated 06.02.2025 passed by Sole Arbitrator Justice Shiv Kirti Singh (Retd.). In this matter, on the request of the Hind Inns & Hotels, Hon’ble High Court vide its order dated 14.10.2025 referred the parties to mediation before the Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre. Where, after attending several negotiation sessions, on 18.12.2025 we have closed the Mediation as Judgment Debtor (Hind Inns) was not serious. The matter is now listed before High Court for hearing on 07.04.2026 and Claimant is in process of filing of Execution Application for enforcement of the Arbitral Award.
